content: If you have problems accessing this workspace, please contact the administrator.

comment.text: Body text of a recovery modal dialog that appears when a user encounters issues accessing a workspace.

<div className={styles.body}>

 productName: getBrandName("ProductName"),
 })}
 onClose={onCloseDialog}
 />
